info.title: VMware VeloCloud SD-WAN Orchestrator
info.description: Authentication: static Orchestrator API token, replayed on every request via the Authorization header. VMware (Broadcom) VeloCloud SD-WAN Orchestrator (VCO) REST API ("APIv2") covering Customer/Edge provisioning, Edge and Profile configuration modules, monitoring, alerts, events, firewall stats, and Gateway migration. Base path is `/api/sdwan/v2`. Preserved here as published, ahead of any curation -- see `vmware_velocloud_sdwan_orchestrator-latest.json` for the trimmed automation subset.

apiToken.name: Authorization
apiToken.description: Static Orchestrator API token, provisioned in the VCO UI under user preferences. Full header value: `Token <api_token>`.

StatsResponse.description: Generic stats/metrics response; concrete shape varies by endpoint.

parameters.name: enterpriseLogicalId
parameters.description: The `logicalId` GUID for the target Customer (Enterprise).

parameters.name: edgeLogicalId
parameters.description: The `logicalId` GUID for the target Edge.

parameters.name: start
parameters.description: Epoch start of the requested time range, in milliseconds.

parameters.name: end
parameters.description: Epoch end of the requested time range, in milliseconds.

parameters.name: interval
parameters.description: Time series bucket interval, e.g. `5min`, `1hour`, `1day`.
